title: The Power of a Stop-Doing List
short_teaser: Growth often creates more activities than a person or business can sustain.
story: Growth often creates more activities than a person or business can sustain. A stop-doing list protects priorities by naming work that will be paused, delegated, or ended. Strategy becomes real when it removes commitments, not only when it adds goals. Strategy is the discipline of choosing what matters most, learning from evidence, and placing limited effort where it can create the greatest useful change. The lasting value is not merely knowing the fact. It is seeing the pattern beneath it and considering where that same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
impact: Strategy becomes real when it removes commitments, not only when it adds goals. Strategy is the discipline of choosing what matters most, learning from evidence, and placing limited effort where it can create the greatest useful change.
spark_application: Identify the decision underneath your current activity. Choose the smallest next move that would create useful information. Save a short note about what you noticed, what surprised you, or what you may want to revisit.
short_title: The Power of a Stop-Doing List
